title: Reference sheet: empty/error states for the intake flow

mockup_description.layout: Three stacked state cards shown as a design-system reference, not a real screen a user lands on all at once.
key_elements: 'Aucun cours en cours' (no course right now) -- icon, message, 'Voir l'emploi du temps' CTA
'Aucun élève trouvé' (no students for this class/group) -- icon, message, 'Contacter l'administration' CTA
'Impossible de charger les données' (load failure) -- icon, message, 'Réessayer' CTA
interactions: Each state has exactly one recovery action -- no dead ends

what_matches: A generic error state exists (setError + inline red banner) for load failures
Empty roster (zero students) renders an empty table rather than crashing
what_differs: None of the three states have the polished icon+message+CTA treatment shown in the mockup -- current states are plain text
No 'Réessayer' retry button on load failure -- the user must reload the page/reselect the class
No distinct 'no course in progress right now' state (not applicable today since there's no today's-agenda view yet -- see 01-mobile-teacher-dashboard.json)

missing_to_add.item: Reusable empty/error-state component (icon + title + description + single CTA) applied consistently across the attendance intake flow
missing_to_add.notes: Purely cosmetic polish -- no functional gap, the app already handles these situations without crashing or leaving a dead end, just not as prettily.

missing_to_add.item: 'Réessayer' retry button that re-fires the failed fetch instead of requiring a manual reload
